restoration_note: The teaching is a doxological litany: 'The Origin (ⲧⲁⲣⲭⲏ) of all X is [Title of the Lord]'. The repeating frame strongly constrains the early fills (ⲧⲁⲣⲭⲏ, ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ, ⲡ-, ⲙⲛ̄). The named registers (Father of Greatness, Mother of Life, Third Ambassador/King of Glory, Beloved of Lights, First Man, Living Spirit/Father of Life, Great Builder, Living Spirit upholding Omophoroi, Jesus the Radiance as Releaser, Virgin of Light, Mind of Light) are recoverable from the litany pattern and from explicit cues like 'looses to raise those bound by his words' (Jesus the Radiance) and 'awakener of the sleepers; gatherer-to-recognition' (Light Mind). The latter half (Sections 622–629) is a damaged climactic peroration about all lights, lives, and souls being under the Mind of Light's hand; the terminal lacunae beyond standard line-break joins ({22}–{24}, {27}–{29}) lack enough trace to constrain a fill and are left unrestorable.
